milestones.name: Defeat Dung Defender
milestones.note: Required prerequisite before accessing Isma's Grove area in Royal Waterways

milestones.name: Acquire Isma's Tear
milestones.note: Found at the end of Isma's Grove after fighting Husk Sentries

milestones.name: Find Dung Defender Sigil
milestones.note: Located above the Husk Sentry area, needed to navigate through the mire

zones.name: Royal Waterways
zones.fingerprintHint: Green acid pools, large coiling root/worm structures, teal bioluminescent glow, Flukes (floating eyeball enemies) present
zones.note: Bottom right section leads to Isma's Grove

zones.name: Isma's Grove
zones.fingerprintHint: Purple/violet light, mossy stone brickwork, green dripping stalactites, glowing white-purple explosion effect
zones.note: Sub-area within Royal Waterways where Isma's Tear is located

abilities.name: Isma's Tear
abilities.grants: Allows the Knight to swim through acid/infected water without taking damage
abilities.note: Also unlocks access to Queen's Gardens and the left half of Kingdom's Edge without acid-platforming detours

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.note: Required prerequisite to reach Isma's Tear (referred to as 'muffling cloak' in transcript)

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Required prerequisite to reach Isma's Tear

abilities.name: Crystal Heart
abilities.note: Required prerequisite; used to cross a crystal platform section in Royal Waterways on the way to Isma's Grove

bosses.name: Dung Defender
bosses.note: Must be defeated before the player can access Isma's Grove; his mire/lair is in the bottom-right of Royal Waterways

bosses.name: Husk Sentry
bosses.note: Arena of Husk Sentries fought just before the room containing Isma's Tear; visible as glowing purple combat in keyframe 2

objectives.name: Defeat Dung Defender
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the bottom-right of Royal Waterways and defeat Dung Defender to unlock access to his mire

objectives.name: Cross crystal platform with Crystal Heart
objectives.hopDescription: Use Crystal Heart to dash across the crystal platform growing out of the ground in Royal Waterways
objectives.note: Follow the crystal formations to the right

objectives.name: Defeat Husk Sentries and find Dung Defender Sigil
objectives.hopDescription: Clear the Husk Sentry arena, then go up to retrieve the Dung Defender Sigil

objectives.name: Navigate through the mire to Isma's Grove
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate through the mire/maze after obtaining the Dung Defender Sigil to reach the room containing Isma's Tear

connectors.description: Bottom-right section of Royal Waterways; requires defeating Dung Defender and using Crystal Heart to cross crystal platforms
connectors.requiresAbilityOrItem: Crystal Heart, Mantis Claw, Mothwing Cloak, Dung Defender defeated

connectors.description: Isma's Tear unlocks acid-free traversal making Queen's Gardens accessible without dangerous platforming
connectors.note: Quality-of-life unlock; previously required extreme acid platforming
